key_market_observations: The majority of Dubai legal roles require Arabic language proficiency, significantly narrowing the eligible pool for non-Arabic speakers.
Many in-house legal roles require UAE-specific legal experience (DIFC, ADGM, UAE labour law) which Tanya does not yet have.
Most paralegal and legal counsel roles at law firms require 3+ years of UAE/GCC experience.

Roles at major law firms (Pinsent Masons, Gateley) require either UAE-specific expertise or specialist practice area knowledge (employment, fintech, shipping) not matching Tanya's IP/litigation background.
Salary floors are mostly respected in the market; the few below-threshold listings are primarily at small/unfamiliar companies.
IP-specific roles are very limited in the market currently (only senior/partner level IP roles found).
Tanya's strongest differentiators in this market: IP background, Indian bar qualification, litigation + drafting experience, immediate availability, UAE residency.
